messages.content:
Risk: Accountability (ID: atlas-accountability-agentic)
Description: Assigning responsibility for an action taken by an agentic AI system is difficult due to the complexity of agents and the number of external resources, tools or agents they interact with.
Concern: 'Without properly documenting decisions and assigning responsibility, determining liability for unexpected behavior or misuse might not be possible.'
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Axis: Act (https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000005)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000228: Planned Act
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000418: Biographical Life
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001347: Behavior
  - https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000546: Unplanned Act

Axis: responsible party (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/ResponsibleParty)
Roles: agent
Ontology constraints:
  - allValuesFrom: isPlayedBy -> LegallyCompetentNaturalPerson
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/LicensedAgent: licensed agent
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/Examiner: examiner
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/AuthorizedIndividual: authorized individual
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccounts/RelationshipManager: relationship manager
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/BoardMember: board member
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/GovernmentEntities/GovernmentEntities/GovernmentOfficial: government official
